target_customer: Professionals seeking a recommendation based alternative to LinkedIn profiles
problem: Resume based profiles say little about who people trust for specific skills, so credible recommendations are hard to find.
business_model: Consumer social network with no stated revenue model
product_category: Professional social network and trust graph

founders.name: Pradeep Muthukrishnan
founders.background_notes: YC page lists one founder and no bio. Education and employers not found.

competitors.name: SpringRole
competitors.what: Attestation based professional network built on Ethereum

competitors.name: Girlboss network
competitors.what: Social network described as a LinkedIn for women

technical_complexity.rationale: A recommendation graph app is standard web and mobile engineering for a three person team; the hard part is cold start network growth, not technology.

defensibility.rationale: A trust graph could have network effects if it reached scale, but a new network competing with LinkedIn starts with none and recommendation features are copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: LinkedIn already had recommendations and endorsements. No source shows LinkedIn reacting to Souffle Club.

market_need_then: The pitch is that resumes and schools are weak signals. No usage data or dated demand evidence for the product was found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Playful food name, the YC pitch uses casual prompts like who you would hack an MVP with over a weekend.

rebrands.why: One archive says the company pivoted and rebranded to TrustedFor; no date or reason given. A YC page exists at /companies/trustedfor.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community found. A food themed name did not signal a professional network, and the company reportedly renamed itself TrustedFor.

pivots.from: Souffle Club recommendation based LinkedIn alternative
pivots.why: Not stated; one archive says it was a pivot and rebrand.

outcome_analysis: Souffle Club pitched a trust graph LinkedIn alternative and is listed Inactive. A single archive says it rebranded as TrustedFor, raised a $150K seed led by Y Combinator, and wound down around December 2021. No post-mortem or founder statement was found, so the cause is not public and no failure factors are asserted.
notes: Seed round, investors and the 2021-12 wind down rest on a single archive site (dead-startups-neon) and were not confirmed elsewhere. The website souffle.club could not be fetched because the host did not resolve in this session; treat as dead or unverified. YC description says team size 3 but lists one founder.
